name: Lightwell
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking up a slot canyon: four nested walls of curved, dipping sandstone close around a bright cyan slit of sky, their broad ledges and fine mica-flecked laminae interlocking in zigzag teeth. A hazy shaft of bounced light slants down through the middle distance while a slow head of out-of-focus dust turns inside it, and the slit sways gently.

params.label: Ledge size
params.effect: Height of the broad sandstone ledges; smaller values give many thin strata, larger values heavy slabs.

params.label: Interlock
params.effect: Depth of the zigzag teeth where broad ledges and fine laminae dovetail; zero gives flat horizontal bands.

params.label: Bounce light
params.effect: How strongly light from the slit bounces down onto the walls, edges, grains and dust.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed at which the teeth, haze and turning dust drift.
